messages:
alex_k: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1427 - tiny rename from `req_id` -> `request_id` but formatter touched a few lines, CI fmt check failing. should I split the formatting into a separate commit?

mira: saw it, thanks. can you split the pure formatting into its own commit? makes the semantic rename easier to review.

alex_k: yep, doing that now. running:
```
git reset --soft HEAD~1
git add -p
git commit -m "refactor: rename req_id -> request_id"
git commit -m "style: run gofmt"
git push -f
```

ci-bot: fmt check failed on pkg/http/handler.go (line wrap > 120). see https://ci.redwood/in/1427 for details.

sam: i can take a quick pass on the rename after you split — ping me when pushed.

jordan: small nit: please update telemetry tags to use `request_id` too (trace/span attrs). also prefer wrapping at 100 cols in this package.

alex_k: good call, will update telemetry tag in the refactor commit so it stays atomic. splitting now and will push shortly.

alex_k: pushed split commits, PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1427

sam: running tools/ci/fmt locally found one import order and an extra blank line. fixed locally and pushed a tiny amend.

sam: LGTM after CI goes green. approving now. :thumbsup:

jordan: approved as well.

merge-bot: merge window opens in 1h 45m. auto-merge policy: requires >=2 approvals and green CI.

alex_k: thanks all — watching CI, will merge once green.
